title: Restructure examples, adding python folder and remove view execution from intro tutorial 00-n2cu
body:
This moves all the merged examples in one of three folders in examples:
- gettingstarted
- python
- tutorials

This will nicely arrange how they look at the website.

Also, I took out the view(structure) command from the 00-n2cu tutorial and replaced it by a codeblock that is not executed. Otherwise, the gui always opens when one builds the html.
